description: REQUIRES prior comwel__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Fetch COMWEL premium billing notice detail.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

detail_context.description: Search context. Pass the search result's `detail_context` object as-is.

detail_keys.description: Detail keys to fetch. Pass the objects from the search result's `detail_candidates` array as-is (filter by insurance_key when needed).

insurance_type.description: Insurance type filter. Required only when detail_keys mixes both types.

name: comwel__info__premium_billing_notice__detail
title: 근로복지공단 보험료 부과고지 상세
